'''2005 U.S. National Championship Joe Giannetti LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2005 U.S. National Championship]], finishing Top 4; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2005-09-29).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35181 Origins 2005 Top 4 - Joseph Giannetti's Leeroyyyy!]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213224729/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35181 Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Giannetti]]
* '''Event:''' [[2005 U.S. National Championship]]

== Original post ==

'''Origins 2005 Top 4 - Joseph Giannetti's Leeroyyyy!'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "mc9457" Carr
* '''Published:''' September 29, 2005
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' The deck Joseph Giannetti used to place top 4 at Origins this year. Somewhat standard WYS (V).

=== Strategy ===

One of the two variants of WYS (V) that was seen at Origins 2005.  Use the Corvette Surprise at Corellia to lay the smackdown on the opponent.
